rows.grounds: adjective modifying karma; compound sense excluded from Veda
first-person singular present active of causative cal

items.question: Why does the speaker declare that he always moves Veda-excluded action for the lord?
premises: Speaker addresses the lord as prabho.
Speaker says he always moves action.
The action is excluded from Veda.
items.inference: The verse presents a confession of performing non-Vedic action under divine address.
uncertainties: Exact sense of cālaye as move versus perform remains context-dependent.
The pronoun te may be genitive or dative.
items.plain_english: Lord, I always set in motion action excluded from the Veda.
